baseline_models.focus_anchor: The passive تُوعَدُونَ leaves the valence of the announced content open, while the emphatic nominal predicate لَوَاقِعٌ characterizes that content as fixed actuality.
baseline_models.mechanism: A spoken promise or threat opens expectation; وقوع then converts the expected content into something that falls into occurrence and holds as reality. The restriction and emphatic predicate compress the gap between announcement and fulfillment.

activation_trace.role: The spoken-promise image supplies an announced good whose fulfillment is still expected.
The threat image preserves harmful announcement as a co-present valence of the passive promise.
Falling into occurrence and becoming fixed reality supplies the decisive transition from speech to actuality.

changed_reading.before: What you are promised will happen.
changed_reading.after: Whatever has been opened as hope or menace is categorically characterized as already belonging to fixed actuality.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: تُوعَدُونَ can carry an appointment within the promise, and لَوَاقِعٌ names that appointment's arrival in actuality.
baseline_models.mechanism: The dominant appointment branch and the packet's non-dominant counted-term mapping overlay schedule on promise: the announced matter has an allotted term, and وقوع is its reaching the assigned slot rather than an unscheduled happening.

activation_trace.role: The appointed-time or appointed-place image gives the promise a bounded rendezvous.
The form-distant counted-term image makes the interval prescribed and finite rather than vague.
Fixed occurrence supplies the expiry or arrival of that measured appointment.

changed_reading.before: The verse asserts an unspecified future fulfillment.
changed_reading.after: The promised matter is a measured appointment whose allotted term reaches actuality.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening oath sequence supplies a functional procession: dispatch initiates, rapid force propels, spreading unfolds, separation sorts, casting deposits reminder, and warning awakens caution. The promise in 77:7 therefore reads as the terminus of a process already sent into motion, not as detached future information.

activation_trace.role: The threat branch supplies the warning-content toward which the procession moves.
Fixed occurrence supplies the procession's eventual arrival in reality.
Successive sending supplies repeated launch and forward continuity.
Light, rapid propulsion supplies acceleration after dispatch.
Opening, spreading, and branching supplies expansion across a field.
Discriminating two things supplies the sorting operation within the procession.
Casting until something lies deposited supplies delivery of the procession's content.
A reminder that makes one remember identifies the deposited content as recall-producing address.
Warning that arouses caution supplies the procession's immediate pragmatic effect before 77:7.

structural_cues: 77:1-6 form a linked participle-plus-masdar sequence whose final excuse-or-warning pair immediately precedes the assertion in 77:7.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the ordered operations and their warning endpoint; I supply the arrow that treats them as stages carrying the promise toward occurrence. A live alternative is that they are separate oath referents rather than temporal stages.

changed_reading.before: The promise is a future proposition backed by assertion.
changed_reading.after: The promise is the arriving result of an already dispatched, accelerating, spreading, sorting, and warning-bearing process.

context_deltas.mechanism: Erasure, opening, and uprooting turn وقوع into coordinated world-reconfiguration; explicit timing, fixed term, and adjudicative separation then identify that reconfiguration as an appointment executed at its deadline. The exploratory appointment baseline becomes a strongly contextualized schedule of judgment.

activation_trace.role: The appointment image supplies a bounded time or place for the promised content.
The overwhelming hard descent supplies the event-scale force of the appointed realization.
Erasing an existing trace supplies the first concrete operation of world-reconfiguration.
Opening a fissure between joined sides supplies structural rupture.
Uprooting and removing from place supplies displacement of what had seemed stable.
Fixing a thing by time or limit makes the sequence scheduled rather than accidental.
A terminal time and prescribed duration supplies the deadline toward which postponement runs.
Judgment that separates truth from falsehood supplies the appointment's function.

structural_cues: 77:8-11 repeat passive conditional transformations, after which 77:12-14 ask and answer the question of the deferred day.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the passive transformation sequence and explicit time-and-judgment lexicon; I infer that the transformations are stages or effects of one promised appointment. They could instead be consequences listed only after the occurrence itself.

changed_reading.before: The promised event is certain but temporally and functionally unspecified.
changed_reading.after: It is a timed appointment whose arrival executes coordinated cosmic dismantling for adjudicative separation.

context_deltas.mechanism: The repeated attribution of falsehood keeps trying to return the promise to the status of mere speech. Against that recurrence, لَوَاقِعٌ functions as a resistance-independent predicate: rejection neither delays the event nor prevents the deniers from being carried into what they deny.

activation_trace.role: The spoken promise supplies the speech act that denial attempts to classify as false.
Fixed actuality supplies the answer to attempts to keep the promise merely verbal.
Attributing speech or its bearer to lying begins the recurring resistance to the announced reality.
The same attribution near the surah's close shows that denial persists across every intervening demonstration.

structural_cues: The identical woe-to-deniers refrain occurs ten times from 77:15 through 77:49, with direct denial also named in 77:29.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated falsehood-attribution around successive demonstrations; I infer that the refrain repeatedly tests and fails the attempt to suspend promised actuality. Alternatively, it may punctuate sections without intensifying the semantics of واقع.

changed_reading.before: The verse makes a positive assertion that the event will happen.
changed_reading.after: The verse also denies denial any causal power: the rejecters are progressively enclosed by the reality they keep calling false.

context_deltas.mechanism: The creation-and-earth block repeatedly places bounded contents into stable receptacles: a secure resting place, an assigned measure, an enclosure that gathers, and fixed anchors. This material pattern activates وقوع as settling into an allotted site, so promised actuality becomes emplacement rather than abstract happening.

activation_trace.role: The appointed-place image gives the promised matter an allotted destination.
Water settling in depressions supplies a material branch of arrival into a receiving place.
Fixity and stable settlement supplies the secure receptacle's holding function.
A quantity reaching its determined limit supplies measured boundedness.
Gathering and gripping within a vessel supplies the earth's containing operation.
Firm rooting supplies visible anchorage within the containing world.

structural_cues: 77:20-27 moves from origin in water, to placement in a secure قرار, to a known measure, then to earth as كفات and mountains as fixed anchors.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated containment, measure, and stability; I map that material arrangement onto the focus predicate as an arrival-that-settles. The live alternative is that the block demonstrates power to fulfill without modifying the manner of وقوع.

changed_reading.before: واقع means that the promised matter will occur in the abstract.
changed_reading.after: The promised matter is pictured as reaching its measure and settling irreversibly into its allotted receptacle.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same shade field is first offered as cover whose protective capacity is negated and later as genuine shelter joined to springs. Protection and recompense make the occurrence distributive: it exposes false refuge for one group while installing real refuge for another, revising a threat-only reading of the promise.

activation_trace.role: The good-promise branch keeps beneficial fulfillment available alongside warning.
The threat branch supplies the harmful side of the differentiated outcome.
Fixed occurrence supplies one reality that makes both outcomes operative.
Shade as cover supplies the apparent refuge whose sheltering function is immediately denied.
Shade as shelter and protection supplies the contrasting real refuge.
Placing oneself within protection identifies the sheltered group's defining relation to harm.
A flowing spring makes the genuine shelter sustaining rather than merely occlusive.
Answering an act with its recompense supplies the rule that distributes realized outcomes.
Doing what is good supplies the conduct to which beneficial recompense answers.

structural_cues: The non-sheltering shade of 77:30-31 is answered by plural shades and springs in 77:41, with the latter block explicitly closed by recompense in 77:44.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the repeated shade lexeme, its opposite protective functions, and recompense; I infer that the promised occurrence installs contrasting destinations. The reward scene could instead be consolation adjacent to, rather than included within, ما توعدون.

changed_reading.before: What is promised is principally a single threatening catastrophe.
changed_reading.after: The occurrence is a discriminating realization: false cover fails while genuine shelter and sustenance become real as recompense.

context_deltas.mechanism: Brief enjoyment, refused bodily lowering, and the final question about any later discourse that could ground assent turn 77:7 into a threshold statement. وقوع closes an interval in which warning can still change posture and belief; after arrival, the promise is no longer one claim among later alternatives.

activation_trace.role: The spoken promise supplies address that can still solicit a response before fulfillment.
Fixed occurrence supplies the boundary after which announced reality is no longer negotiable.
Extension that reaches its limit supplies a finite interval of present enjoyment.
Fewness and smallness sharply contract that remaining interval.
Humility and lowering supply the bodily response commanded and refused while response remains possible.
Discourse renewed as report supplies the hypothetical later message whose adequacy is denied.
After-position in sequence supplies the terminal ordering of any imagined subsequent address.
Heart-settling assent supplies the response for which no later discourse is left as a plausible ground.

structural_cues: 77:46 contracts enjoyment, 77:48 records a refused imperative, and 77:50 closes with a rhetorical question about belief after this discourse; woe refrains separate the steps.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the shortened duration, refused posture, and no-later-discourse question; I infer that وقوع is the boundary closing the response interval. The final question may instead assert this discourse's sufficiency without making a chronological claim about the event.

changed_reading.before: The promise is one warning that listeners may continue to weigh against later messages.
changed_reading.after: It marks the last response-bearing horizon: once promised reality lands, the interval for changed posture and settled assent has closed.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the focus gives no explicit animal, blow, or battle, and both branches are peripheral material images. It remains anchored in تُوعَدُونَ and لَوَاقِعٌ as a signal-to-impact sequence; downstream prose should present it only as an acoustic and kinetic analogy, not as the words' direct gloss.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The movement from the warning-bearing تُوعَدُونَ to the impact-bearing لَوَاقِعٌ permits a tightly bounded pre-impact reading.

activation_trace.role: A threatening bellow immediately before attack supplies warning as an audible pre-impact event.
The mark and sound of a strike supplies the answering collision in which the warning becomes contact.

changed_reading.before: A verbal warning reports a later blow.
changed_reading.after: The warning can be heard as the sound immediately before impact, with واقع naming the collision that answers it.

strongest_changes: The opening procession makes the promise an already dispatched process rather than detached future information.
The cosmic passive sequence and time lexicon turn generic certainty into a fixed appointment for adjudicative reconfiguration.
Repeated denial makes واقع explicitly resistance-independent: calling the promise false cannot suspend its actuality.
Containment and anchorage materialize occurrence as measured settlement, while opposed shades show that settlement distributes distinct outcomes.
summary.what_was_special: Whole-surah activation repeatedly moved 77:7 from abstract futurity into process, schedule, material emplacement, contested speech, and differentiated arrival without detaching any reading from its two focus roots.
remaining_uncertainties: The opening oath sequence may identify witnesses or agents rather than stages of one process.
The measured-settlement model may be a contextual material analogy rather than a semantic sharpening of واقع.
The scope of ما توعدون may foreground threat more strongly than the reward-bearing branch allows.
The counted-term baseline depends partly on a legitimate but non-dominant mapped root and should remain exploratory.
